mechanism: Ritonavir inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase levodopa levels; additionally, protease inhibitors can potentiate dopaminergic effects and increase risk of adverse CNS effects including psychosis and dyskinesias.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa adverse effects (dyskinesias, psychosis, orthostatic hypotension, nausea); consider levodopa dose reduction if toxicity develops; maintain close clinical supervision.
